meta.title: Hammerprice: sell a card
meta.description: Consign graded cards from your wallet and run an auction.

gate.connectBody: Selling starts from your own wallet. Connecting shows us your public address only. Hammerprice never holds your cards or your money.
gate.signBody: Sign a short message to prove the wallet is yours. It is not a transaction, it costs nothing and nothing moves.
gate.mismatch: You are signed in with a different wallet than the one connected now. Sign in again with this wallet.
gate.noWallet: No wallet yet? It is free and takes about two minutes.

home.title: Sell a graded card
home.lede: Choose a card, set a price and pick a start time. Hammerprice runs the auction. When it ends, you and the winner each confirm one transaction: the money comes to you and the card goes to the winner.
home.coreOnly: Only Metaplex Core cards can be sold for now. Every other card says why it cannot.
home.needEligible: You need at least one eligible card first.
home.recent: Auctions you created in this browser
home.recentNote: This list lives in this browser only. An auction belongs to your wallet.

assets.rpcDown: We could not read your wallet from the network right now. Try again in a moment.
assets.empty: We found no cards in this wallet.
assets.emptyDevnet: We found no cards in this wallet. On devnet you can mint a free test card below.
assets.summary: {total, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} found, {eligible} eligible to sell.
assets.listedRoom: Already in a room. Open the room
assets.listedPack: Already in a pack. Open the pack

reasons.not_found: We could not find this card on the network.
reasons.unsupported_standard: Only Metaplex Core cards can be sold for now. This card uses: {standard}.
reasons.not_owner: This card is not in your signed-in wallet.
reasons.frozen: The card is frozen, so it cannot be transferred.
reasons.royalty_rules_block_transfer: The royalty rules of the card would block a plain transfer to the buyer.
reasons.foreign_delegate_blocks: Another address holds a lock on this card, for example a listing elsewhere. Remove it first.
reasons.already_listed: This card is already in a room, a sale or a pack. A card can be offered in one place at a time. It becomes available again when it is sold, unsold or withdrawn.

mint.title: Get a test card
mint.body: This puts one free replica card in your wallet so you can try the whole flow.
mint.done: Done. {name} is in your wallet. It appears in your list in a moment.
mint.rateLimited: You have reached the limit of 3 test cards per day. Try again in {wait}.
mint.paused: Minting test cards is paused right now.
mint.notHere: Test cards are only available on devnet.
mint.failed: We could not mint a card. Try again in a moment.

wizard.title: New auction

pick.title: Choose your card
pick.body: Pick the card you want to sell. The cards come from your signed-in wallet, and each one says whether it can be sold. One auction can hold up to {max} cards.
pick.emptyTitle: No cards in this wallet yet
pick.empty: There are no cards in this wallet yet.
pick.noneEligible: None of your cards can be sold right now. Each card says why.
pick.emptyDevnet: You have no cards yet. Press the button below to get a free test card.

terms.reserveHint: The card only sells if the highest bid reaches this price. Bidders can see it. Leave it empty for no minimum.
terms.incrementHint: The smallest step between two bids.

issues.amount_invalid: Use digits with up to 6 decimals, for example 12.50.
issues.amount_zero: The amount must be more than zero.
issues.amount_too_large: The amount is above the limit of 1,000,000 USDC.
issues.reserve_below_opening: The minimum price cannot be lower than the starting price.

show.name: Auction title
show.nameHint: Optional. We use the card name if you leave it empty. Bidders see it.
show.startShown: Starts {when}, shown in your time zone.

issues.title_too_short: The title needs at least 3 characters.
issues.title_too_long: The title can have at most 80 characters.
issues.title_characters: The title has characters we do not allow. Use letters, digits and common punctuation.
issues.start_invalid: That is not a valid date and time.
issues.start_too_soon: Pick a start time at least 5 minutes from now, or choose Start now.

publish.title: Is your card ready?
publish.explain: We check that the card is in your wallet and can be sent. You do not sign anything for this check and nothing moves.
publish.ruleAuto: Every lot closes by itself when its timer ends. A bid in the last seconds can extend the timer. Nobody has to end the sale by hand. The highest valid bid wins if it reaches your minimum price.
publish.ruleCosign: When a lot sells, you co-sign the delivery. One transaction sends the card to the winner and the USDC to you, and both of you sign it. Neither of you can move the card or the money alone.
publish.ruleOnline: You must stay online until the settlement window closes. By default that is 15 minutes after the lot ends. If you do not co-sign in time, the sale does not complete and your account gets a strike.
publish.ruleWithdraw: You can withdraw a lot only before its first bid.
publish.needReady: Publish unlocks when every card is ready.
publish.invalid: Something changed. Go back and check the prices and the start time.
publish.summary: When the timer ends, the highest bid wins if it reaches your minimum price. Then you and the winner each confirm one transaction: the card goes to the winner and the money comes to you. Stay online for 15 minutes after the end.
publish.ruleFee: The fee is 2.5% of the final price, taken from your payout. The buyer pays nothing on top.

wizard.autoTitle: {count, plural, one {{name} auction} other {{name} and {more} more}}

price.title: Set your price
price.body: Prices are in USDC, a digital dollar.
price.bodyMany: These prices apply to all {count} cards. You can set them card by card under Advanced options.
price.fee: Hammerprice takes 2.5% of the final price from your payout. The buyer pays nothing on top. With a minimum price, the card only sells when the highest bid reaches it.

time.heading: Lot length, start time and go live
time.title: When should it start?
time.nowHint: The auction opens as soon as you publish.
time.scheduleHint: Pick a date and time. Bidders see a countdown.

duration.title: How long does each lot run?
duration.hint: Each lot runs {duration}. A bid in the last {window} adds time, in total at most {max} more. 45 seconds is the usual length; a longer lot gives bidders more time to decide.

manage.title: Manage show
manage.notFound: We could not find this show.
manage.noStart: No start time set. Start it yourself when you are ready.
manage.rules: Lots close by themselves. You can withdraw or extend a lot only while it has no bid, and change the reserve only before it opens. When a lot sells you co-sign the delivery, so stay online until the settlement window closes. Ending a show stops new lots from opening. A lot that is already open runs to its end.
manage.withdrawLocked: This lot has a bid, so it can no longer be withdrawn or extended.
manage.extended: The timer was extended by {seconds} seconds.

pause.hint: Pause stops all bidding and holds the clock. When you resume, the lot gets back the time it had, so nobody loses a second. Everyone in the room sees that you paused. At most {max} pauses per show, each ends by itself after {minutes} minutes, and not in the last {seconds} seconds of a lot.
pause.state: The room is paused. Bidding resumes by itself at {when} at the latest.
pause.limit: All pauses of this show are used.
pause.noLot: A pause needs a lot on the block.
pause.late: Not possible in the last 10 seconds of a lot.

manage.paused: The room is paused. Everyone sees it.
manage.resumed: The room is running again. The lot kept its time.

errors.banned: This wallet is not allowed to use Hammerprice.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.wrong_state: That is not possible in the current state.
errors.nonce_used: That sign-in was already used. Sign in again.
errors.expired: The sign-in expired. Sign in again.
errors.wrong_domain: The sign-in was made for another site. Reload the page and try again.
errors.paused: This part of Hammerprice is paused right now.
errors.balance_unavailable: We could not read the balance right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.rpc_unavailable: The network did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.self_bid: You cannot bid on your own lot.
errors.already_high_bidder: You are already the high bidder.
errors.no_paddle: No bidding number is registered for this show.
errors.not_buyable: This lot cannot be bought now.
errors.not_seller: Only the seller of this show can do that.
errors.not_owner: A card is not in your signed-in wallet any more.
errors.frozen: A card is frozen and cannot be transferred.
errors.unsupported_standard: A card uses a token standard we cannot sell yet. Only Metaplex Core works for now.
errors.lots_not_ready: Some lots are not ready yet. Check the cards again.
errors.seller_not_allowed: This wallet is not allowed to sell yet, or you have reached the daily limit of shows.
errors.not_buyer: Only the buyer can do that.
errors.not_party: You are not part of this sale.
errors.already_listed: A card is already in a room, a sale or a pack. A card can be offered in one place at a time. Choose another card.
errors.asset_not_ready: A card is not ready to be transferred. Check the cards again.
errors.tx_mismatch: The transaction does not match the sale. Nothing was signed.
errors.blockhash_expired: The signing round ran out. Start it again.
errors.round_expired: The signing round ran out. Start it again.
errors.counterparty_pending: The other party has not signed yet.
errors.simulation_failed: The network test of the transaction failed. Nothing moved.
errors.faucet_paused: Claiming test USDC is paused right now.
errors.mint_paused: Minting test cards is paused right now.
errors.feature_off: This feature is not available here.
errors.payment_required: This needs credit. Buy a pack of credits first.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI draft is not available right now. A template draft still works.
errors.ai_budget: The AI budget for today is used up. Try again tomorrow or use a template draft.
errors.vrf_pending: The random draw is not finished yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.video_unavailable: The live video is not available right now. The show carries on without it.
errors.muted: You are muted in this chat.
errors.mainnet_config_incomplete: This site is not fully set up for real payments yet. Nothing was sent.
errors.cluster_config_conflict: The network settings of this site contradict each other. Nothing was sent.
errors.show_paused: The room is paused. Resume it first.
errors.pause_limit: This show has used all its pauses.
errors.pause_too_late: A lot cannot be paused in its last 10 seconds.
